title: Small business websites on the first page of Google, 2026
description:
Open dataset from a study by Veilvex: 178 small-business websites from the first page of Google in 24 cities worldwide, checked in October 2026 for HTTPS, mobile viewport, title and meta description, tap-to-call, WhatsApp and Telegram links, contact forms, prices, structured data (JSON-LD, LocalBusiness), AI crawler blocking, load time and page weight. 157 sites opened. Includes the anonymized CSV, summaries by niche and city, and the checking script.

Article: https://veilvex.com/blog/small-business-websites-study-2026/
